about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Our story in serving your eyes
about.body: Zando Optics (Z & O Optics) is a specialized store in Baghdad offering prescription glasses, sunglasses and contact lenses from the finest authentic international brands. We are proud to be the official agent for Swiss OptiSwiss lenses in Iraq, and we are committed to providing precise, world-standard eye examinations by a select team of specialists. Our mission is to give every client clearer vision and finer style.
about.mission: To be Iraq's leading optics destination in quality, authenticity and service.
about.vision: To spread a culture of eye-health care and provide the latest optical solutions to every client.
